headword: {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}

definitions.explanation: The degree to which customers are pleased with a product, service, or experience. A core concept in business management, often measured through surveys and used as a key performance indicator.

examples.japanese: {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}{度|ど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧⟦させたい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We want to improve customer satisfaction.

examples.japanese: {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}{度|ど}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}した→分析する：25338_bunsekisuru⟧。
examples.english: We analyzed the results of the customer satisfaction survey.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、アフター⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: To maintain high customer satisfaction, thorough after-sales service is essential.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧ (customer/client) + ⟦{満足|まんぞく}→満足：02496_manzoku⟧ (satisfaction). Often abbreviated as CS in business jargon. This is a standard business term found in corporate reports, marketing materials, and management discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}{度|ど}: customer satisfaction level/score (often abbreviated CS)
- {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}{度|ど}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: customer satisfaction survey
- {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to increase customer satisfaction
- {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧: improvement of customer satisfaction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- CS (シーエス): customer satisfaction (abbreviation) — the abbreviated form commonly used in business
- ⟦{利用者|りようしゃ}→利用者：03189_riyousha⟧⟦{満足|まんぞく}→満足：02496_manzoku⟧⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧: user satisfaction level — for public services rather than commercial customers
- ⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧⟦{満足|まんぞく}→満足：02496_manzoku⟧: employee satisfaction — the internal equivalent, measuring staff happiness
